items.title: Why long-form writing and blogs will continue to thrive in spite of AI

We already see this in school and college, in which millions of students have taken to using chatbots to expedite the often tedious process writing essays, or for homework assistance, to the chagrin of teachers and administrators, who see now their roles as ‘AI detectors’ than educators.
